projects.name: Air Quality Index (AQI) Analysis
projects.description: A comprehensive statistical exploration examining urban air quality indicators across Indian metropolitan areas. Investigates key pollutant concentrations including PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, and CO to detect seasonal shifts, emission hotspots, and health index correlations.

projects.name: Smart Route & Delivery Optimizer
projects.description: A computational route-planning model that formulates logistics networks as directed weighted graphs. Employs Minimum Spanning Trees (MST) and shortest-path heuristics to model hub interconnections and streamline package dispatch efficiency.

projects.name: QueueLess: Canteen Crowd Predictor
projects.description: A student-centric analytics application concept engineered to forecast university cafeteria congestion levels. Correlates scheduled class dismissal times, historical meal-rush peaks, and student traffic to recommend optimal low-wait dining intervals.
